commitResults.messageBody: Track completion separately from task descriptions so users can mark an existing task done and see its status when listing tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add unmark command for task reopening
commitResults.messageBody: Allow users to reverse a task's completion state and confirm the updated not-done status.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce Task domain class
commitResults.messageBody: Keep each task's description and completion state together, and move status changes and display formatting into the new Task abstraction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add repeatable Level 4 UI testing guardrail
commitResults.messageBody: Record exact task-type acceptance cases and require the fail-fast test-ui workflow after application changes so regressions are visible immediately.

commitResults.messageBody:
Test methods use underscore-separated names.

They do not follow the Java method naming convention.

Rename the affected methods to use camelCase.

This keeps test behavior and coverage unchanged.
